frames.vm3: vintage-matched rows (base year equal to the decision year) under the consensus-present rule: an in-window PROSPX consensus read, FanGraphs and MLB Pipeline optional
frames.vintage_matched_common: the same rows restricted to those FanGraphs and MLB Pipeline both graded (the vm1 and vm2 membership rule), re-derived here

basis.efv: eFV v1 refit in every draw, scored with the MATRIX consensus input (the vm1 convention carried by the vm2 headline); the development read applies the timing pin to its rows, so its n sits at or under this lab's

protocol: cluster paired bootstrap, resampled BY PLAYER over the eFV matrix pool, forward chain refit inside every draw, both legs scored on the consensus-present rows the resampled players own; both frames scored inside the same draw. MDE95 = 1.645 * sd(delta), one-sided

vm3.reading: development only; a floor, not a claim

vintage_matched_common.reading: development only; a floor, not a claim

paired_difference.note: the frames share their draws; the sd is the paired difference's

not_a_claim: a development floor on a spent frame; vm2 stays the headline and no served number reads this file
